item.title: Magic’s Decision Desk: From simulated sign-in to real-device validation
item.description: M7’s recorded 12-step real-device plan passed with iPhone Face ID and Windows Hello, and 14 simulated unauthorized requests were refused. M7f adds development hardening: 448 tests run, suite OK with one skipped, plus 31/31 simulated browser checks. Production authentication is NOT DEPLOYED. Trading is DISABLED. M7f’s changed device-approval and emergency-lock behavior still awaits a focused real-device check. Evidence checkpoint: 3 November 2026.
